verses.en: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
verses.pt: Ó Deus a quem eu louvo, não fiques calado.
verses.en_web: God of my praise, don’t remain silent,
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker. Of David. A Psalm.> God of my praise, let my prayer be answered;

verses.en: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.
verses.pt: Porque a boca do perverso, e a boca enganadora já se abriram contra mim; falaram de mim com língua falsa.
verses.en_web: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.
verses.en_bbe: For the mouth of the sinner is open against me in deceit: his tongue has said false things against me.

verses.en: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.
verses.pt: E me cercaram com palavras de ódio; e lutaram contra mim sem motivo.
verses.en_web: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.
verses.en_bbe: Words of hate are round about me; they have made war against me without cause.

verses.en: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.
verses.pt: Fizeram-se contra mim por causa de meu amor; porém eu me mantenho em oração.
verses.en_web: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.
verses.en_bbe: For my love they give me back hate; but I have given myself to prayer.

verses.en: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
verses.pt: Retribuíram o bem com o mal, e o meu amor com ódio.
verses.en_web: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
verses.en_bbe: They have put on me evil for good; hate in exchange for my love.

verses.en: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.
verses.pt: Põe algum perverso contra ele, e que haja um acusador à sua direita.
verses.en_web: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.
verses.en_bbe: Put an evil man over him; and let one be placed at his right hand to say evil of him.

verses.en: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.
verses.pt: Quando for julgado, que saia condenado; e que a oração dele seja considerada como pecado.
verses.en_web: When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.
verses.en_bbe: When he is judged, let the decision go against him; and may his prayer become sin.

verses.en: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.
verses.pt: Sejam os dias dele poucos, e que outro tome sua atividade.
verses.en_web: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.
verses.en_bbe: Let his life be short; let another take his position of authority.

verses.en: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
verses.pt: Sejam seus filhos órfãos, e sua mulher seja viúva.
verses.en_web: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
verses.en_bbe: Let his children have no father, and his wife be made a widow.

verses.en: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.
verses.pt: E que seus filhos andem sem rumo, e mendiguem; e busquem para si longe de suas ruínas.
verses.en_web: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.
verses.en_bbe: Let his children be wanderers, looking to others for their food; let them be sent away from the company of their friends.

verses.en: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.
verses.pt: Que o credor tome tudo o que ele tem, e estranhos saqueiem seu trabalho.
verses.en_web: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.
verses.en_bbe: Let his creditor take all his goods; and let others have the profit of his work.

verses.en: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.
verses.pt: Haja ninguém que tenha piedade dele, e haja ninguém que se compadeça de seus órfãos.
verses.en_web: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.
verses.en_bbe: Let no man have pity on him, or give help to his children when he is dead.

verses.en: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
verses.pt: Sejam seus descendentes cortados de vez; e que o nome deles seja apagado da geração seguinte.
verses.en_web: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.
verses.en_bbe: Let his seed be cut off; in the coming generation let their name go out of memory.

verses.en: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
verses.pt: Que a perversidade de seus pais seja lembrada pelo SENHOR, e que o pecado de sua mãe não seja apagado.
verses.en_web: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by Yahweh. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.
verses.en_bbe: Let the Lord keep in mind the wrongdoing of his fathers; and may the sin of his mother have no forgiveness.

verses.en: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
verses.pt: Porém que tais coisas estejam sempre perante o SENHOR, e corte-se a lembrança deles da terra.
verses.en_web: Let them be before Yahweh continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;
verses.en_bbe: Let them be ever before the eyes of the Lord, so that the memory of them may be cut off from the earth.

verses.en: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.
verses.pt: Porque ele não se lembrou de fazer o bem; ao invés disso, perseguiu ao homem humilde e necessitado, e ao de coração quebrado, para o matar.
verses.en_web: because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.
verses.en_bbe: Because he had no mercy, but was cruel to the low and the poor, designing the death of the broken-hearted.

verses.en: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.
verses.pt: Já que ele amou a maldição, então que ela lhe sobrevenha; e já que ele não quis a bênção, que esta se afaste dele.
verses.en_web: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.
verses.en_bbe: As he took pleasure in cursing, so let it come on him; and as he had no delight in blessing, let it be far from him.

verses.en: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.
verses.pt: E ele seja revestido de maldição, como se lhe fosse sua roupa, como água dentro do seu corpo, e como óleo em seus ossos.
verses.en_web: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.
verses.en_bbe: He put on cursing like a robe, and it has come into his body like water, and into his bones like oil.

verses.en: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
verses.pt: Que ela seja como uma roupa com que ele se cubra, e como cinto com que ele sempre põe ao seu redor.
verses.en_web: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.
verses.en_bbe: Let it be to him as a robe which he puts on, let it be like a band which is round him at all times.

verses.en: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.
verses.pt: Isto seja o pagamento do SENHOR para os meus adversários, e para os que falam mal contra minha alma.
verses.en_web: This is the reward of my adversaries from Yahweh, of those who speak evil against my soul.
verses.en_bbe: Let this be the reward given to my haters from the Lord, and to those who say evil of my soul.

verses.en: But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name’s sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.
verses.pt: Porém tu, Senhor DEUS, me trata bem por causa do teu nome; por ser boa a tua misericórdia, livra-me;
verses.en_web: But deal with me, Yahweh the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;
verses.en_bbe: But, O Lord God, give me your help, because of your name; take me out of danger, because your mercy is good.

verses.en: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
verses.pt: Porque estou aflito e necessitado; e meu coração está ferido dentro de mim.
verses.en_web: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.
verses.en_bbe: For I am poor and in need, and my heart is wounded in me.

verses.en: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
verses.pt: Eu vou como a sombra, que declina; estou sendo sacudido como um gafanhoto.
verses.en_web: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.
verses.en_bbe: I am gone like the shade when it is stretched out: I am forced out of my place like a locust.

verses.en: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.
verses.pt: Meus joelhos estão fracos de tanto jejuar; minha carne está magra, sem gordura alguma.
verses.en_web: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.
verses.en_bbe: My knees are feeble for need of food; there is no fat on my bones.

verses.en: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.
verses.pt: E eu por eles sou humilhado; quando me veem, sacodem suas cabeças.
verses.en_web: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.
verses.en_bbe: As for me, they make sport of me; shaking their heads when they see me.

verses.en: Help me, O LORD my God: O save me according to thy mercy:
verses.pt: Socorre-me, SENHOR Deus meu; salva-me conforme a tua bondade;
verses.en_web: Help me, Yahweh, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;
verses.en_bbe: Give me help, O Lord my God; in your mercy be my saviour;

verses.en: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, LORD, hast done it.
verses.pt: Para que saibam que esta é a tua mão; e que assim tu a fizeste.
verses.en_web: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, Yahweh, have done it.
verses.en_bbe: So that they may see that it is the work of your hand; that you, Lord, have done it.

verses.en: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.
verses.pt: Maldigam eles, mas bendize tu; levantem-se eles, mas sejam envergonhados; e o teu servo se alegre.
verses.en_web: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.
verses.en_bbe: They may give curses but you give blessing; when they come up against me, put them to shame; but let your servant be glad.

verses.en: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.
verses.pt: Que meus adversários se vistam de vergonha, e cubram-se com sua própria humilhação, como se fosse uma capa.
verses.en_web: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
verses.en_bbe: Let my haters be clothed with shame, covering themselves with shame as with a robe.

verses.en: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
verses.pt: Agradecerei grandemente ao SENHOR com minha boca, e no meio de muitos eu o louvarei;
verses.en_web: I will give great thanks to Yahweh with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.
verses.en_bbe: I will give the Lord great praise with my mouth; yes, I will give praise to him among all the people.

verses.en: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.
verses.pt: Porque ele se põe à direita do necessitado, para o livrar daqueles que atacam a sua alma. Salmo de Davi:
verses.en_web: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.
verses.en_bbe: For he is ever at the right hand of the poor, to take him out of the hands of those who go after his soul.
